Implemented a deeper shell-level fix. The prior control-bar tweak was not enough because the overscroll was coming from the dashboard container stack, not the page content itself.

What was actually wrong
1. The shared sidebar shell used viewport-based height classes in normal flow:
Sidebar.tsx
Sidebar.tsx
Sidebar.tsx

2. In Electron, the app content is offset by a titlebar height, so those viewport-height classes could exceed the usable content area by a small amount, creating the slight vertical page scroll and top-button clipping.

3. The root container was also allowing page-level scroll:
App.global.css

Fix applied
1. Converted sidebar shell sizing from viewport-driven to parent-constrained sizing:
- Sidebar.tsx
- Sidebar.tsx
- Sidebar.tsx

2. Hardened dashboard wrapper constraints:
- DashboardPage.tsx

3. Prevented top-level renderer scrolling and made root height consistently use titlebar variable:
- App.global.css
